mcp.description: Adventure Works — the bike retailer's operational database. Use this server for questions about products and their bills of materials (component parts), product models and categories, sales orders and order details, customers, and sales reps and territories. Read-only, governed tools; the model never writes SQL (NL2DAB). Call describe_entities first to see the available entities and fields.

ProductComponents.description: A quick, FLAT top-level parts list for a product — only the direct (level-1) components, one row each, no sub-assemblies expanded. Ask by product MODEL name (for example 'Touring-1000', 'Mountain-100', 'Road-150'). Read-only, backed by a single SQL view. Use this for a fast at-a-glance parts list; for the COMPLETE multi-level bill of materials (every part, all the way down) use get_product_bom instead.

fields.name: ProductModel
fields.description: Product model name, e.g. 'Touring-1000'. Filter on this field to get one product's flat top-level parts list.

fields.name: ComponentName
fields.description: Name of a component part used in the product, e.g. 'HL Touring Frame' or 'HL Headset'.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: How many of this component are used per finished product.

fields.name: UnitOfMeasure
fields.description: Unit of measure for the quantity, e.g. 'Each'.

Products.description: Products Adventure Works makes or sells (bikes, components, clothing, accessories). Useful columns: ProductID, Name, ProductNumber, Color, Size, StandardCost, ListPrice, ProductModelID, ProductSubcategoryID, SellStartDate. Look up a product here to get its ProductID for bill-of-materials tools.

fields.name: ProductID
fields.description: Surrogate primary key for the product; used by bill-of-materials tools.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Product name, e.g. 'Road-150 Red, 62'.

fields.name: ProductNumber
fields.description: Unique product SKU / part number, e.g. 'BK-R93R-62'.

fields.name: MakeFlag
fields.description: 1 = manufactured in-house, 0 = purchased from a vendor.

fields.name: FinishedGoodsFlag
fields.description: 1 = a salable finished product, 0 = a component/sub-assembly.

fields.name: Color
fields.description: Product color, e.g. 'Red', 'Black'.

fields.name: SafetyStockLevel
fields.description: Minimum inventory quantity to keep on hand.

fields.name: ReorderPoint
fields.description: Inventory level that triggers a reorder.

fields.name: StandardCost
fields.description: Standard cost to make or buy the product.

fields.name: ListPrice
fields.description: Selling (list) price.

fields.name: Size
fields.description: Product size, e.g. '58', 'L'.

fields.name: SizeUnitMeasureCode
fields.description: Unit of measure for Size (e.g. 'CM').

fields.name: WeightUnitMeasureCode
fields.description: Unit of measure for Weight (e.g. 'G', 'LB').

fields.name: Weight
fields.description: Product weight.

fields.name: DaysToManufacture
fields.description: Number of days required to make the product.

fields.name: ProductLine
fields.description: Product line code: R=Road, M=Mountain, T=Touring, S=Standard.

fields.name: Class
fields.description: Product class: H=High, M=Medium, L=Low.

fields.name: Style
fields.description: Style code: W=Womens, M=Mens, U=Universal.

fields.name: ProductSubcategoryID
fields.description: Foreign key to ProductSubcategories.

fields.name: ProductModelID
fields.description: Foreign key to ProductModels (the model name that groups color/size variants).

fields.name: SellStartDate
fields.description: Date the product became available for sale.

fields.name: SellEndDate
fields.description: Date the product was withdrawn from sale (null if still sold).

fields.name: DiscontinuedDate
fields.description: Date the product was discontinued (null if active).

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: Row global unique identifier used for replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Timestamp the row was last modified.

ProductCategories.description: Top-level product categories: Bikes, Components, Clothing, Accessories. Columns: ProductCategoryID, Name.

fields.name: ProductCategoryID
fields.description: Surrogate primary key for the category.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Category name: Bikes, Components, Clothing, or Accessories.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: Row global unique identifier used for replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Timestamp the row was last modified.

ProductSubcategories.description: Product subcategories under each category (e.g. Road Bikes, Mountain Bikes, Wheels, Helmets). Columns: ProductSubcategoryID, ProductCategoryID, Name.

fields.name: ProductSubcategoryID
fields.description: Surrogate primary key for the subcategory.

fields.name: ProductCategoryID
fields.description: Foreign key to the parent ProductCategories row.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Subcategory name, e.g. 'Road Bikes', 'Helmets', 'Wheels'.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: Row global unique identifier used for replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Timestamp the row was last modified.

ProductModels.description: Product models. A model groups color/size variants under one name, e.g. 'Touring-1000'. Columns: ProductModelID, Name. Join Products.ProductModelID to a model.

fields.name: ProductModelID
fields.description: Surrogate primary key for the product model.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Model name that groups color/size variants, e.g. 'Touring-1000'.

fields.name: CatalogDescription
fields.description: XML marketing/catalog description for the model.

fields.name: Instructions
fields.description: XML manufacturing instructions for the model.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: Row global unique identifier used for replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Timestamp the row was last modified.

SalesOrders.description: Sales order headers — one row per customer order. Columns: SalesOrderID, OrderDate, DueDate, ShipDate, CustomerID, SalesPersonID, TerritoryID, SubTotal, TaxAmt, Freight, TotalDue, Status, OnlineOrderFlag. Line items are in SalesOrderDetails (join SalesOrderID).

fields.name: SalesOrderID
fields.description: Surrogate primary key for the order.

fields.name: RevisionNumber
fields.description: Number of times the order has been revised.

fields.name: OrderDate
fields.description: Date the order was placed.

fields.name: DueDate
fields.description: Date the order is due to the customer.

fields.name: ShipDate
fields.description: Date the order shipped (null if not yet shipped).

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Order status code: 1=In process, 2=Approved, 3=Backordered, 4=Rejected, 5=Shipped, 6=Cancelled.

fields.name: OnlineOrderFlag
fields.description: 1 = placed online by the customer, 0 = taken by a sales rep.

fields.name: SalesOrderNumber
fields.description: Human-readable order number, e.g. 'SO43659'.

fields.name: PurchaseOrderNumber
fields.description: Customer's purchase-order number.

fields.name: AccountNumber
fields.description: Financial account number for the order.

fields.name: CustomerID
fields.description: Foreign key to Customers.

fields.name: SalesPersonID
fields.description: Foreign key to SalesPeople (BusinessEntityID) — the rep who took the order; null for online orders.

fields.name: TerritoryID
fields.description: Foreign key to SalesTerritories.

fields.name: BillToAddressID
fields.description: Foreign key to the billing address.

fields.name: ShipToAddressID
fields.description: Foreign key to the shipping address.

fields.name: ShipMethodID
fields.description: Foreign key to the shipping method.

fields.name: CreditCardID
fields.description: Foreign key to the credit card used.

fields.name: CreditCardApprovalCode
fields.description: Approval code returned by the card processor.

fields.name: CurrencyRateID
fields.description: Foreign key to the currency exchange rate applied.

fields.name: SubTotal
fields.description: Order subtotal before tax and freight.

fields.name: TaxAmt
fields.description: Tax amount on the order.

fields.name: Freight
fields.description: Freight (shipping) charge.

fields.name: TotalDue
fields.description: Total amount due = SubTotal + TaxAmt + Freight.

fields.name: Comment
fields.description: Free-text comment on the order.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: Row global unique identifier used for replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Timestamp the row was last modified.

SalesOrderDetails.description: Sales order line items — one row per product on an order. Columns: SalesOrderID, SalesOrderDetailID, ProductID, OrderQty, UnitPrice, UnitPriceDiscount, LineTotal. Join SalesOrderID to SalesOrders and ProductID to Products.

fields.name: SalesOrderID
fields.description: Foreign key to the SalesOrders header.

fields.name: SalesOrderDetailID
fields.description: Surrogate primary key for the line item.

fields.name: CarrierTrackingNumber
fields.description: Shipment tracking number for this line.

fields.name: OrderQty
fields.description: Quantity of the product ordered on this line.

fields.name: ProductID
fields.description: Foreign key to Products.

fields.name: SpecialOfferID
fields.description: Foreign key to the special offer applied to this line.

fields.name: UnitPrice
fields.description: Selling price per unit.

fields.name: UnitPriceDiscount
fields.description: Discount per unit (as a fraction).

fields.name: LineTotal
fields.description: Computed line total: OrderQty * UnitPrice after discount.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: Row global unique identifier used for replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Timestamp the row was last modified.

Customers.description: Customers. Columns: CustomerID, PersonID, StoreID, TerritoryID, AccountNumber. A customer is an individual (PersonID) and/or a store (StoreID); join TerritoryID to SalesTerritories.

fields.name: CustomerID
fields.description: Surrogate primary key for the customer.

fields.name: PersonID
fields.description: Foreign key to the individual person (null for pure store customers).

fields.name: StoreID
fields.description: Foreign key to the reseller store (null for individual consumers).

fields.name: TerritoryID
fields.description: Foreign key to SalesTerritories.

fields.name: AccountNumber
fields.description: Customer account number, e.g. 'AW00000001'.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: Row global unique identifier used for replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Timestamp the row was last modified.

SalesPeople.description: Sales representatives. Columns: BusinessEntityID (the sales rep's id — this is the SalesPersonID on orders), TerritoryID, SalesQuota, Bonus, CommissionPct, SalesYTD, SalesLastYear.

fields.name: BusinessEntityID
fields.description: The sales rep's id; this is the SalesPersonID referenced on SalesOrders.

fields.name: TerritoryID
fields.description: Foreign key to the rep's SalesTerritories row.

fields.name: SalesQuota
fields.description: The rep's annual sales quota.

fields.name: Bonus
fields.description: Bonus amount earned by the rep.

fields.name: CommissionPct
fields.description: Commission percentage on sales.

fields.name: SalesYTD
fields.description: Rep's sales year-to-date.

fields.name: SalesLastYear
fields.description: Rep's sales in the prior year.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: Row global unique identifier used for replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Timestamp the row was last modified.

SalesTerritories.description: Sales territories / regions. Columns: TerritoryID, Name, CountryRegionCode, [Group] (e.g. North America, Europe, Pacific), SalesYTD, SalesLastYear.

fields.name: TerritoryID
fields.description: Surrogate primary key for the territory.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Territory name, e.g. 'Northwest', 'Canada', 'France'.

fields.name: CountryRegionCode
fields.description: ISO country/region code, e.g. 'US', 'CA', 'FR'.

fields.name: Group
fields.description: Region group the territory belongs to: North America, Europe, or Pacific.

fields.name: SalesYTD
fields.description: Territory sales year-to-date.

fields.name: SalesLastYear
fields.description: Territory sales in the prior year.

fields.name: CostYTD
fields.description: Territory cost year-to-date.

fields.name: CostLastYear
fields.description: Territory cost in the prior year.

fields.name: rowguid
fields.description: Row global unique identifier used for replication.

fields.name: ModifiedDate
fields.description: Timestamp the row was last modified.

GetWhereUsedProductID.description: Reverse bill of materials: for a given component ProductID, returns every assembly/product that USES that component (recursively), as of a date. Parameters: StartProductID (the component's ProductID), CheckDate (as-of date).

parameters.name: StartProductID
parameters.description: ProductID of the COMPONENT part to trace upward (Production.Product.ProductID). Returns every assembly/product that uses this component, recursively.

parameters.name: CheckDate
parameters.description: As-of date (yyyy-MM-dd) for the bill-of-materials validity; only BOM links effective on this date are followed.

fields.name: ProductAssemblyID
fields.description: ProductID of the assembly/product that uses the component.

fields.name: ComponentID
fields.description: ProductID of the component (matches the StartProductID input).

fields.name: ComponentDesc
fields.description: Name/description of the component product.

fields.name: TotalQuantity
fields.description: Total quantity of the component required by the assembly, aggregated across the BOM path.

fields.name: StandardCost
fields.description: Standard cost of the assembly product, in USD.

fields.name: ListPrice
fields.description: List price of the assembly product, in USD.

fields.name: BOMLevel
fields.description: Bill-of-materials level of the assembly within the product hierarchy.

fields.name: RecursionLevel
fields.description: Depth of recursion from the starting component (0 = direct parent assembly).

GetManagerEmployees.description: Org chart DOWN: returns all employees who report (directly or indirectly) to the given manager. Parameter: BusinessEntityID (the manager's id).

parameters.name: BusinessEntityID
parameters.description: BusinessEntityID of the MANAGER (HumanResources.Employee). Returns everyone who reports to this person, directly or indirectly.

fields.name: RecursionLevel
fields.description: Depth in the org chart below the manager (0 = the manager's direct reports level).

fields.name: OrganizationNode
fields.description: Hierarchyid path of the employee within the organization, as a string.

fields.name: ManagerFirstName
fields.description: First name of the employee's immediate manager.

fields.name: ManagerLastName
fields.description: Last name of the employee's immediate manager.

fields.name: BusinessEntityID
fields.description: BusinessEntityID of the reporting employee.

fields.name: FirstName
fields.description: First name of the reporting employee.

fields.name: LastName
fields.description: Last name of the reporting employee.

GetEmployeeManagers.description: Org chart UP: returns the management chain above an employee, from the employee up to the top. Parameter: BusinessEntityID (the employee's id).

parameters.name: BusinessEntityID
parameters.description: BusinessEntityID of the EMPLOYEE (HumanResources.Employee). Returns the management chain above this person, up to the top of the org.

fields.name: RecursionLevel
fields.description: Depth up the management chain from the starting employee (0 = the employee).

fields.name: BusinessEntityID
fields.description: BusinessEntityID of the person at this level of the chain.

fields.name: FirstName
fields.description: First name of the person at this level of the chain.

fields.name: LastName
fields.description: Last name of the person at this level of the chain.

fields.name: OrganizationNode
fields.description: Hierarchyid path of the person within the organization, as a string.

fields.name: ManagerFirstName
fields.description: First name of this person's manager (next level up).

fields.name: ManagerLastName
fields.description: Last name of this person's manager (next level up).

GetProductBOM.description: Returns the FULL multi-level bill of materials (every component part, recursively, with quantities and costs) for a product MODEL name, e.g. 'Touring-1000'. Use this when a flat top-level parts list is not enough and you need the complete assembly tree.

parameters.name: ProductModel
parameters.description: Product model name, e.g. 'Touring-1000'. Resolved to a ProductID, then its full recursive bill of materials is returned.

fields.name: ProductAssemblyID
fields.description: ProductID of the parent assembly that directly contains this component.

fields.name: ComponentID
fields.description: ProductID of the component part.

fields.name: ComponentDesc
fields.description: Name/description of the component product.

fields.name: TotalQuantity
fields.description: Total quantity of the component required by its parent assembly, aggregated across the BOM path.

fields.name: StandardCost
fields.description: Standard cost of the component product, in USD.

fields.name: ListPrice
fields.description: List price of the component product, in USD.

fields.name: BOMLevel
fields.description: Bill-of-materials level of the component within the product hierarchy (1 = top-level part of the finished product).

fields.name: RecursionLevel
fields.description: Depth of recursion from the finished product (0 = its direct components).
